EMERALD SOUL DIAMOND 75 ml

Ibraq

350 MAD

From the enchanting twilight skies and the gentle breeze that carries the whispers of nature, Emerald Soul Diamond emerges as a fragrant embodiment of the night’s first promises. Bergamot and mandarin blend seamlessly with amber and vanilla, creating a soft radiance that gracefully drifts through the horizon. Fragrance Notes: Emerald Soul Diamond: Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, White Musk Heart Notes: Refreshing Spices, Lemon Base Notes: Vanilla, Amber
